pages.name: conformance
pages.title: sf-admin-shell against component.json (standard simai.smart-component 1.4 §12, gate 20)
pages.format: stands/15-scenarios (A4 modal: a page, probes in steps); the runner is ui-source tests/browser/manifest-probes.browser.mjs, run for the package by scripts/run-manifest-probes.mjs

checks.title: the page's parts are placed: the skip link first, the menu in its column, the head and the content in the main landmark
checks.covers: slots menu head, accessibility skip link, main

steps.script: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !document.querySelector('#s .sf-admin-shell__main'); i += 1) await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 100)); return Boolean(document.querySelector('#s .sf-admin-shell__main')); })()
steps.check: document.querySelector('#s .sf-admin-shell').firstElementChild.classList.contains('sf-admin-shell__skip') && document.querySelector('#s [data-area=menu] #m1') !== null && document.querySelector('#s main [data-area=content] #c1') !== null && document.querySelector('#s main [data-area=head] sf-header-page') !== null

checks.title: open-menu reflects menu-open and says sf-admin-shell-menu-open {reason: api}; close-menu says sf-admin-shell-menu-close and removes it
focus-content moves the focus to the main landmark
